finalText:
**94 files, 1082 hits.** Most of it is internal `services/*` code, safe to rename.

Four places must stay `account_id`:

| Location | Why |
|---|---|
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | public API contract, frozen field name |
| `lib/serialize.js:8` | wire-format map, right side is the public JSON key |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/**` | generated/vendored, comment says "do not edit" |
| `migrations/*.sql` | already applied in prod, renaming a column needs a new migration, not an edit |

`lib/audit.js` is internal-only, safe to rename along with the services.

Next: scope the PR to `services/*` and `lib/audit.js`, add a new migration for the DB column, and bump the OpenAPI version only if the wire field ever changes.
